# Tiger Downs championship artwork

Both assets were created with built-in image generation and optimized as WebP for the game. The renderer loads them without blocking the existing math game and keeps the original horse renderer as a fallback.

## Gallop sheet

`gallop-hd-v37.webp`: eight complete horse-and-jockey frames, four columns by two rows. Every frame includes the horse, rider, saddle, helmet, reins and all four legs. The runtime applies selected coat and silk colors without changing the shared practice bank or rewards.

Prompt: A high-resolution transparent sprite sheet of the same athletic chestnut thoroughbred and teal-clad racing jockey, true orthographic right-facing side view, eight chronological phases of a continuous gallop. Premium realistic 3D sports game render, detailed muscles, flowing dark mane and tail, leather tack and natural reins. Fixed scale and body alignment; four anatomically correct legs; eight equal cells with transparent margins. No scenery, labels, text, shadows, grid, logos or watermarks.

## Championship course

`championship-course-v37.webp`: a wide racetrack panorama. Separate scrolling speeds for the distant stands, dirt and foreground rail create depth without changing the horses' racing positions.

Prompt: A realistic 3D sports game championship horse-racing course, strictly side-on at track level. Warm afternoon sunlight, blue sky, leafy oaks, red-brick racing pavilion, elegant packed grandstands, cream canopies, teal-and-gold banners without text, horizontal white safety rail, uninterrupted finely groomed dirt foreground. Match left and right edges for scrolling. No horses, jockeys, vehicles, people on track, words, logos, interface or watermark. Wide 3:1 panorama.
